text:
alex.k: Heads-up — we have a short maintenance window tonight 23:00 UTC to pin runtime -> v2.14.1 and deploy a minor kernel patch for Dedicated (EU region). No data migrations. Expected customer impact: brief 30–45s token-serving stalls per routed request while instance restarts.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job queued: runtime-pin-v2.14.1 @ 2025-06-12T23:00:00Z. Canary pool: 3 nodes. Rollout batch size: 15%. Auto-rollback: enabled if error-rate > 3% for 5m.

sam: Quick Q — does this require customers to re-pin models on their side?

alex.k: No. This is infra runtime pin; model versions unaffected. Only teams using dedicated pinned capacity might see a brief reconnection.

maria: Drafting statuspage & customer email. Posting snippets here for review.
maria: ```Status update (maintenance):
Scheduled maintenance: Infrastructure runtime pin + patch (EU Dedicated)
Start: 2025-06-12 23:00 UTC
Duration: ~45 minutes
Impact: Short interruptions for requests routed to affected nodes (up to ~1 minute total per request). No model or data changes.```

jordan: Suggest adding guidance for customers with strict SLAs — include fallback routes and contact link.

maria: Good call. Adding: "If you require uninterrupted throughput, consider routing to a different region or enabling multi-region fallback prior to the window. Contact support@redwood.ai for assistance."

support-bot: Suggested email subject: "Planned maintenance: Dedicated EU runtime pin on 2025-06-12"
support-bot: Suggested email body snippet: ```Hi <customer>,
We will perform a planned runtime pin and minor patch in the EU Dedicated fleet on 2025-06-12 23:00 UTC. You may experience short interruptions to inference (expected <1 minute per routed request). No data migrations or model changes are required.
If you have strict SLA needs, reply to this email or open a support ticket and we can help route traffic away from the maintenance batch.
— Redwood Inference Ops```

sam: Rollback playbook confirmation? If canary shows errors, do we auto-rollback full batch or pause and triage?

alex.k: Auto-rollback will pause the rollout and revert the affected batch only. On pause we alert eng-oncall and support. Escalation: if revert fails twice, we hold and notify customers via statuspage update.

maria: Ready to publish. I'll post to Statuspage 15m before start and send email 2h before. Draft link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/rc-2025-06-12-runtime-pin (placeholder)

jordan: Add a short post-window note for customers to verify traffic routing & report anomalies within 24h.

alex.k: Agreed. I'll trigger the deploy and monitor canary. If anything unexpected, I'll post updates here and we push to statuspage. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2025-06-12T22:54:00Z. Canary results: OK (latency+error within baseline). Proceeding to batch 1.

support-bot: Published statuspage preview. Will go live at 2025-06-12T22:45:00Z. Email queued for 21:00 UTC send.

maria: Thanks all — tagging @support for watch during the window.

alex.k: Final note: no customer-facing changelog required beyond statuspage/email. Keep this thread for post-mortem notes if needed.
